BehaviorTree._description: Calibrate the pose of the Gemini 305 wrist camera in gripper_end from views of a ChArUco board fixed in the workspace, and draw the solved camera and board poses in the 3D view. Run Generate reBot Calibration Waypoints first. The solved pose is the wrist_camera_color_optical_xyz/rpy mount. The stock driver publishes no point cloud, so the closing snapshot step fails on hardware after the solve. See https://docs.picknik.ai/how_to/robotics_applications/camera_calibration/.

SubTree.input_port: The ChArUco board fixed in the workspace. Match your print: squares along x and y, square and marker side lengths in meters, dictionary.
